name: zen-free
description: 使用公共免登录凭证接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，自动发现当前免费模型并支持流式对话和工具调用。

summary.zh: 免登录接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，自动发现当前免费列表。
summary.en: Access OpenCode Zen free models with the public credential, automatic discovery, and native streaming.

description.zh: 使用公共凭证（public）接入 OpenCode Zen 当前提供的免费模型，无需个人 API 密钥。自动发现模型目录，支持原生流式协议与工具调用。
description.en: Access free models currently offered on OpenCode Zen using the public credential without a personal API key. Automatically discovers available free models with native streaming and tool calls.

risk.zh: 非官方社区维护插件。免费模型列表与可用性由上游服务决定，随时可能调整；首次安装需下载 Bun 运行环境。
risk.en: Unofficial community-maintained plugin. Free model availability is controlled by the upstream service and may change at any time; first installation downloads the Bun runtime.
